Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the client group used to access the data source
ClusterId.description_zh: 访问数据源使用的客户端组 ID

ConnectionInfo.description_en: The connection information of the data source, which describes how to access the data source
ConnectionInfo.description_zh: 数据源连接信息，描述如何访问这个数据源

DataSourceId.description_en: The ID of the data source

DataSourceName.description_en: The name of the data source

DataSourceType.description_en: The type of the data source

Exclude.description_en: The filter that specifies the files to exclude. This parameter is used only for data source analysis in the archiving feature. Do not use it in other scenarios
Exclude.description_zh: 用于描述排除哪些文件的过滤器。仅用于归档功能中的数据源分析，其他场景请勿使用

Include.description_en: The filter that specifies the files to include. This parameter is used only for data source analysis in the archiving feature. Do not use it in other scenarios
Include.description_zh: 用于描述包含哪些文件的过滤器。仅用于归档功能中的数据源分析，其他场景请勿使用

IndexAvailable.description_en: Indicates whether the index is available. This parameter is used only for data source analysis in the archiving feature. Do not use it in other scenarios
IndexAvailable.description_zh: 索引是否可用。仅用于归档功能中的数据源分析，其他场景请勿使用

IndexLevel.description_en:
The index level. Valid values:

OFF: No index is created.
META: Metadata index.
ALL: Full-text index. [Deprecated]
IndexLevel.description_zh:
索引等级。

OFF：不创建索引
META：元数据索引
ALL：全文索引（已废弃）

IndexUpdateTime.description_en: The index update time. This parameter is used only for data source analysis in the archiving feature. Do not use it in other scenarios
IndexUpdateTime.description_zh: 索引更新时间。仅用于归档功能中的数据源分析，其他场景请勿使用

Indexing.description_en: Indicates whether an index is being created. This parameter is used only for data source analysis in the archiving feature. Do not use it in other scenarios
Indexing.description_zh: 是否正在建立索引。仅用于归档功能中的数据源分析，其他场景请勿使用

Options.description_en: The data source analysis options. This parameter is used only for data source analysis in the archiving feature. Do not use it in other scenarios
Options.description_zh: 数据源分析选项。仅用于归档功能中的数据源分析，其他场景请勿使用

Paths.description_en: The list of paths for data source analysis. This parameter is used only for data source analysis in the archiving feature. Do not use it in other scenarios
Paths.description_zh: 数据源分析的路径列表。仅用于归档功能中的数据源分析，其他场景请勿使用

items.description_en: The path for data source analysis. This parameter is used only for data source analysis in the archiving feature. Do not use it in other scenarios
items.description_zh: 数据源分析的路径。仅用于归档功能中的数据源分析，其他场景请勿使用

PlanId.description_en: The ID of the analysis plan. This parameter is used only for data source analysis in the archiving feature. Do not use it in other scenarios
PlanId.description_zh: 分析计划ID。仅用于归档功能中的数据源分析，其他场景请勿使用

Schedule.description_en: The execution cycle. This parameter is used only for data source analysis in the archiving feature. Do not use it in other scenarios. Format: I{startTime}{interval}. This indicates that a task is executed every {interval} starting from {startTime}. startTime: the start time, which is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. interval: an ISO 8601 time interval. For example, PT1H indicates an interval of one hour, and P1D indicates an interval of one day
Schedule.description_zh:
执行周期。仅用于归档功能中的数据源分析，其他场景请勿使用。
格式：I{startTime}{interval}。表示从{startTime}开始每隔{interval}的时间执行一次任务。startTime：起始时间，UNIX时间，单位为秒。 interval： ISO8601时间间隔。例如：PT1H表示间隔一小时。P1D表示间隔一天

SpeedLimit.description_en: The throttling limit. This parameter is used only for data source analysis in the archiving feature. Do not use it in other scenarios
SpeedLimit.description_zh: 限流。仅用于归档功能中的数据源分析，其他场景请勿使用

Message.description_en: The message returned. If the request is successful, "successful" is returned. If an error occurs, the corresponding error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页页码。从1开始，默认值为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 99. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页大小。最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true表示成功。
false表示失败
